channel.title: Blend incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Blend's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Closings flowing from Encompass to Blend via EPC and PDD [resolved]
Encompass Disclosure Delivery Errors [resolved]
item.description:
Per ICE Mortgage Technology's status page, a client-side fix for the Send Disclosures error has been released via critical patch 26.2.0.4, and has been deployed to both UAT and Production Encompass environments.
Action required: To receive the patch, users will need to log out of the Encompass Smart Client and log back in.
Several clients have confirmed service is restored after applying the patch. If you continue to experience issues sending Disclosures after logging back in, please reach out to the ICE/Encompass Support Team.

item.title: Issues affecting closing packages and disclosures through docusign [resolved]
item.description:
We scaled up processing capacity on our end to work through the backlog of signature and package completion events between DocuSign and Blend. This backlog has now fully processed, and document e-sign tasks are reflecting completion status successfully. RON, Hybrid Closings, Disclosures, and Follow Up flows using eSign functionality are operating normally.
Thank you for your patience while we worked through this issue.

item.title: Blend platform production availability is restored [resolved]
EPD Encompass Integration - Experiencing delays [resolved]
item.description:
The Blend Engineering Team has identified the cause of the intermittent delays affecting our Encompass Partner Document Delivery (PDD) integration, and service has returned to normal.
Our Engineering team has implemented mitigations to restore stability and will continue to monitor the environment closely to ensure the issue does not recur.
We are also continuing work on additional improvements to further strengthen the resiliency of the integration.
Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve this issue.

item.title: CLOSING - Users may be experiencing troubles sending closing Packages to Blend [resolved]
item.description: The fix for this issue has now been deployed, and we believe the matter is fully resolved.

item.title: Twilio outage [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting delivery of multi-factor authentication codes sent via SMS short code appears to be resolved. Service has recovered, and users should now be able to receive MFA codes as expected.

item.title: Cloudflare Outage [resolved]
item.description: Cloudflare has reported that traffic engineering efforts have successfully mitigated the majority of congestion and packet drops. Please refer to the linked Cloudflare status page for the latest provider updates.

item.title: Ongoing Investigation into Platform Performance Degradation [resolved]
Service Notice: Integration Connectivity Disruption between Encompass and Blend [resolved]
Encompass (ICE) Degraded Performance [resolved]
item.description: Encompass confirmed the issue on their end has been resolved and all services remain in a stable state.

item.title: 502 Error When Accessing Blend Beta Environments [resolved]
item.description:
The issue impacting Blend Beta environments has been resolved, and the beta environments are now functioning normally.
We will continue to monitor closely to ensure ongoing stability. Please feel free to reach out to us if you encounter any issues.
Thank you for your patience while we worked through this issue.

item.title: eClose - Hybrid Closing Packages (manually tagged only) [resolved]
item.description: Resolved but still monitoring. Continue to send Hybrid Closing packages.

item.title: Blend - Unable to Access [resolved]
item.description: All affected services including Blend Signing Room (RONs) and Public API have been recovered.

item.title: Application Export latency (stuck) incident [resolved]
item.description: We have identified the impacted applications and re-exported applications stuck "in progress." We have started sending out impact lists individually to any impacted clients.

item.title: Issues identified with AUS/DU/LPA requests in Blend [resolved]
item.description:
AUS Functionality Fully Restored
We have successfully resolved and confirmed the full restoration of AUS functionality. You can now run AUS as expected. Please note that this incident was strictly confined to AUS; there were no other known or expected impacts to any other Blend features or user data.
Thank you for your patience as our team worked to deploy this fix quickly. We appreciate your partnership.

item.title: Major Amazon Web Services (AWS) Outage [resolved]
item.description: Our application export queues have returned to normal levels. At this time, we believe that this incident is resolved, although some of Blend's integration partners may continue to experience issues as they recover.
